name: the_blur
conceit: One long-exposure-photography frame per beat: a single sharp, still figure held in tack focus while the surrounding crowd streams past as unresolved motion-blur ghosts -- the miracle is rendered as the moment sharpness overtakes blur, not as a new pose or a cut.

anti: a calm, uncrowded scene with no real river of motion to hold still against -- the device needs a genuinely busy, moving crowd for the one sharp figure to read against
a beat that needs to show a face in emotional close-up -- the style's whole point is one small still figure against a blurred field, not a portrait

plate_bill.must_contain: one sharp, still gaunt man on a mat in the lower third, a river of translucent motion-blur crowd-ghosts streaming diagonally toward an unseen pool
the same porch corner; a second figure caught mid-resolution, lower body still blurred, upper body and stance already tack-sharp, standing at the feet of the lying man
the same porch corner, now empty and fully sharp with no blur remaining: an abandoned rumpled mat on bare stone, a calm glassy pool in the distance

motion_slots.earned_by: the resolving-out-of-blur moment (P2) is the one beat where real motion earns a paid clip; the hook and landing hold as $0 stills.

beat_template.hook: one sharp man still among a river of blurred, hurrying strangers
beat_template.pivot: a second figure resolves out of the blur into full sharp focus, arriving
beat_template.landing: the porch empty and still, blur gone, one abandoned mat, the pool calm

score_shape: a restless, low string bed under the streaming crowd-blur, cutting to a single clear tone the instant the second figure resolves sharp, settling to near-silence over the empty resolved landing.
